title: Kinhold Update: Added day/night/weather/lights/sound/music
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is made with Claude. Apologies for the loud starting music, the two different music tracks are not equalized to the same volume, so working on that. What has been added: day/night/moon cycles, added clouds and weather, added lights (tested with a hip lamp on the character for the clip), added sound fx and biome ambience sounds, and music!  Whats not seen, is the start of the Settler/Settlement system, improved building mechanics, and the improved UI.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body:
Its not an RPG, but it does have stats. It is a voxel survival/settlement sim game. As you explore the world and discover resources and enemies, your settlers and settlement expand on their own. They will gather resources that you want, craft items that you want, farm, ranch, eat food, and eventually you equip them with better and better gear (just like yourself) and fight off enemy raids, then attacking small outposts, before fighting large settlements. Right now I am aiming for up to 300 villagers.  
It has been ongoing for about 3 weeks, and I was testing with Synty assets but now moved 99% to Blender models (still using one of their characters, though). Each game will be a randomized voxel world, 6km x 6km x 512m in size. Right now the basics have been added, but so many systems are intertwined its taking a lot to make sure they are working together properly. Wanted to post an update video on just some of the visual changes over the last few days. I have no idea on the token cost, never tracked it, and I am working on about 8 projects right now. The main issues right now, are the voxel world - still having trouble blending some of the voxel materials properly. Otherwise, everything is going pretty good!
